description: Self-rental income fully recharacterized leaves a ZERO absorption pool, but the SS 469(i) allowance still applies to active-participation rental losses: single filer, passive income 10,000 all self-rental -> pool 0, absorbed 0; remaining rental-active losses 30,000; AGI 90,000 < 100,000 so the full 25,000 cap survives -> allowed 25,000, suspended 5,000. Hand-computed: min(30000, 30000-0)=30000 capped at 25000; 43,636-analog check: 30,000-25,000=5,000 suspended.
